images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A narrative puzzle game screen seen from above a dream-surgeon's velvet workbench in dusky violet and rose light. At the center a torn, slightly curled photograph shows a soft painterly memory diorama: a 12th birthday party room with pastel bunting, a cake with blue candles glowing warm, a small boy in a party hat at the table, and an older brother by the front door turning a glinting brass key. Glowing champagne-gold suture threads pin the photo's torn corners to the bench and stitch its top edge. A dashed gold selection frame marks the brother as the action being replaced. Left: a tray of tactile enamel tiles for person, action and emotion; one tile lifted and glowing. Right: a pinned request card and a crimson wax seal with a key emblem reading '집 열쇠는 형만 가지고 있다'. Bottom: a suture bar with three slots joined by thread, status '논리 연결 성립', button '이 기억을 봉합'. Title '기억의 봉합사'. Soft bloom, film grain, vignette. Text constraints: the lifted glowing action tile and the middle suture slot read exactly "문을 잠근다" (not 열다); the person slot reads "형"; emotion tiles read "온기" and "두려움".

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same dream-surgery workbench at the moment of failure, flooded with pulsing crimson and magenta light. A bright red contradiction thread has snapped mid-air between the halves, frayed ends curling, tiny sparks scattering. The crimson key wax seal on the left glows hot as the violated fact. Right panel shows result 모순 1 and memory stability collapse. Bottom suture bar with two shaking rose-red tiles and a broken thread. Large glowing serif headline '꿈의 거부 반응' at top, subtitle about the key and the locked door. Painterly soft 2D-3D hybrid, dramatic rim light, bloom, film grain. Continuity with image A: the child at the cake is the same small boy in a party hat, the erased figure is his older brother, and all text uses "형" (never 오빠); no dates anywhere; the wax seal bears a key emblem.
